in_marathi.name: Nandikaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nandikaa is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'Nandana', which means 'delightful' or 'joyful'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Krishna, who is known as 'Nandana-sutaa' or 'son of Nanda', and is often depicted as a source of joy and happiness. Nandikaa is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in the Hindu tradition.
